subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Must realtime Talk gain explicit phone capability negotiation before merge, or may the Android/Wear release contract require matched phone and watch versions?
rationale: The existing v1 capability identifier does not distinguish the newly added RPC and audio-channel support, and only maintainers can choose the supported staggered-upgrade contract for the bundled mobile release.

options.title: Add feature negotiation
options.body: Advertise realtime Talk support separately and hide or disable the watch control until the preferred phone confirms the new protocol surface.

options.title: Require matched versions
options.body: Explicitly accept synchronized phone/watch versions, document the requirement, and prove that staggered upgrades fail with a clear recoverable state rather than an ambiguous broken control.

recommendation.title: Add feature negotiation
recommendation.body: Advertise realtime Talk support separately and hide or disable the watch control until the preferred phone confirms the new protocol surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the latest hardening commits on the exact routing and metadata surfaces requiring this release-contract choice.
